value.rationale: The canonical truncated-tetrahedral graph already has a known 22-dimensional H3 and rational symmetry character. Its smallest induced sphere classes form natural geometric generators; their classification and integral span answer a motivated local-to-global question. A unique order-two obstruction among rationally spanning triples of symmetry orbits is not implied by abstract homotopy or rational representation data. The full census and integer lattice comparison are structurally meaningful finite invariants, not a routine re-expression of a Betti number.
